Author, your total image set is sized at 24.54 MB. That's murder on mobile devices with limited data plans and can deter readers from wanting to look at your page.

Can you resize the images so they're not so big? Let me know if you would like assistance with that.

item.content:encoded: This is an incredible use of Nobody, I'm impressed. Usually I'm not a fan of these kinds of formats because of how pedestrian they are, but this is a welcome change. I much prefer the genuine handwritten format over the neo-handwritten stylized font of some other Nobody formats. +1
